notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Changelog of v.1.0.1:
- Fixed Terry Bogard's command list
- Fixed bug when changing video settings during online multiplayer play
- Fixed issues with Pause menu
- Minor bug fixes in menus

Thank you for playing  GAROU: MotW on Steam!

Additional future updates are coming soon for an even better game experience. Stay tuned GAROU fans!
